summary: LUNA COMMAND is an interactive mission control training module designed for aspiring junior astronauts. By simulating real-world lunar mission telemetry, life support monitoring, and emergency checklist protocols, it transforms complex aerospace operations into an intuitive, hands-on learning experience for students.
details:
What it does:

LUNA COMMAND (Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer) is an interactive mission control training platform designed to introduce students to spacecraft operations and lunar mission management.

How it works:

The system breaks down mission control duties into three core modules:

1. Life Support Telemetry: Tracks simulated cabin pressure, oxygen reserves, and power levels.

2. Lunar Orbit Alignment: Walks junior astronauts through orbital alignment and South Pole descent readiness checks.

3. Anomaly Response: Presents simulated system alerts where users follow standard aerospace troubleshooting checklists.

Impact & Creativity:

Instead of passive reading, LUNA COMMAND puts students in the seat of a NASA Flight Controller, building critical thinking and systems awareness through accessible interactive drills.
